title.zh: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
title.en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】

current_state.zh: Swell 正在调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，暂无 ETH 从相关存款或提款合约流出；此前 Spreek 报告的疑似管理员密钥泄露和四个恶意升级合约仍处于调查中。
current_state.en: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity and says no ETH has flowed out of the relevant deposit or withdrawal contracts; the suspected admin-key leak and four malicious upgrade contracts reported by Spreek remain under investigation.

updates.title_zh: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
updates.title_en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
updates.what_changed_zh: 链上分析师 Spreek 报告称，Swell DAO 的 swETH 和 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，攻击者每小时将净值抬高最多 1%，并部署了四个恶意升级合约，可能危及约 2500 ETH。
updates.what_changed_en: Chain analyst Spreek reports a suspected leak of Swell DAO's swETH and rswETH admin keys, with attackers inflating NAV by up to 1% per hour and deploying four malicious upgrade contracts that could endanger roughly 2,500 ETH.

updates.title_zh: 【Swell：正调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，暂无资金流出】
updates.title_en: 【Swell：正调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，暂无资金流出】
updates.what_changed_zh: Swell 官方表示正与安全合作伙伴调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，并采取预防措施；同时称目前暂无 ETH 从存款或提款合约流出，用户无需采取行动。
updates.what_changed_en: Swell officially said it is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity with security partners and taking precautionary measures; it stated that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts and users need not take action.
updates.current_state_zh: Swell 正在调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，暂无 ETH 从相关存款或提款合约流出；此前 Spreek 报告的疑似管理员密钥泄露和四个恶意升级合约仍处于调查中。
updates.current_state_en: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity and says no ETH has flowed out of the relevant deposit or withdrawal contracts; the suspected admin-key leak and four malicious upgrade contracts reported by Spreek remain under investigation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity amid reports of a possible admin-key compromise and malicious upgrade contracts, while stating that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity amid reports of a possible admin-key compromise and malicious upgrade contracts, while stating that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts.
